title: Beyond Trial-and-Error: Agentic Optimization for Image-to-Video Adherence
abstract: arXiv:2608.12290v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern black-box Image-to-Video (I2V) models offer powerful capabilities in automated content creation, yet their lack of fine-grained control and reliability presents significant challenges in professional workflows. Their inherent stochasticity causes minor variations in textual prompts or hyperparameters to yield drastically different outputs often necessitating inefficient, brute-force trial-and-error processes. To address these limitations, we introduce the ``Agentic Self-Improvement" framework, which reframes video synthesis into a closed-loop, goal-directed optimization. Our framework systematically navigates the generation parameter space using a novel two-stage approach. In the first stage, an iterative prompt optimization loop uses a multimodal Large Language Model (mLLM) to refine the input prompt. translated_title: 超越试错法：图像到视频一致性的智能体优化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12290v1 公告类型：交叉提交 摘要：现代黑盒图像到视频（I2V）模型在自动化内容创作中提供了强大的能力，但其缺乏细粒度控制和可靠性，在专业工作流程中带来了重大挑战。其固有的随机性导致文本提示或超参数的微小变化可能产生截然不同的输出，通常需要低效的、蛮力式的试错过程。为了解决这些限制，我们引入了“智能体自我改进”框架，将视频合成重新构建为闭环、目标导向的优化。我们的框架使用一种新颖的两阶段方法系统地导航生成参数空间。在第一阶段，迭代提示优化循环使用多模态大语言模型（mLLM）来细化输入提示。这种细化实现了两种自动化评估：戴维森场景图（DSG）查询确保语义一致性，以及通用性评估。
tldr: 本文提出了一种“智能体自我改进”框架，通过两阶段优化（迭代提示优化和参数导航）将图像到视频生成转变为闭环目标导向过程，以解决黑盒模型的随机性和缺乏控制问题，从而避免低效的试错。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an "Agentic Self-Improvement" framework that transforms image-to-video generation into a closed-loop, goal-directed optimization via a two-stage approach (iterative prompt refinement and parameter navigation), addressing stochasticity and lack of control in black-box models to avoid inefficient trial-and-error.
